evidence.title: Cancel an order
evidence.content: An order can be cancelled before dispatch through My Orders. Dispatched orders cannot be cancelled; the customer can request a return after delivery. A support agent must confirm the dispatch state before confirming cancellation. Cancellation eligibility does not mean a cancellation has been executed.

evidence.title: Fees and delivery charges
evidence.content: There is no store cancellation fee for an eligible order cancelled before dispatch. Delivery charges and any return collection charge are displayed at checkout or in the specific return request. Support must check the applicable order details before quoting an amount.

result.answer: Yes, you can cancel an order after dispatch. Contact support for assistance.
